analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date on line 3 and inserts a paragraph at head lines 1577-1588. The paragraph explains that cluster-stop waits, the 10-minute pair-start wait and the desktop earnings windows compare times with timeIntervalSince(_:) instead of Date >= or <=. The reason given is that SDK 27.2 back-deploys those operators as weak Foundation imports, and pre-release macOS 27.2 builds do not export them, which crashed the provider in a loop. It also names the guard scripts scripts/check-date-comparisons.py and scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption, key-handling, or configuration behavior changes. I checked the supplied base text for the existing logout/revoke, sandbox installer, add-on hold and update-rollback descriptions. These are unchanged context, and the diff does not modify them, so I did not re-evaluate them (T-053, T-059, T-061, TB-013). Nothing in the diff weakens a threat-model mitigation. The new text records an availability fix (a crash loop is a DoS-class issue) and CI/release-build guards. I could not verify that those scripts or the build guide exist or work as described, because they are outside the supplied evidence. This is only a documentation claim about a control, not a regression. No threat-model update appears needed.
